name: Desk Stretches
description: Guided 1 to 4 minute stretch breaks for your neck, back, wrists and eyes, read aloud so you don't have to look.
prompt: A desk stretching guide with three routines, each stretch with an emoji, instructions read aloud, left and right sides, a countdown ring, pause and skip, a count of breaks done and optional reminders every 30 minutes, hour or two hours.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Pausas guiadas de 1 a 4 minutos para estirar cuello, espalda, muñecas y ojos, leídas en voz alta para que no tengas que mirar.
